title: Hard Problems
definition: Problems requiring advanced data structures (Tries, Segment Trees) or complex DP/Graph algorithms. E.g., Alien Dictionary, Trapping Rain Water, N-Queens.

answers.question: **Basic:** Describe the fundamental approach for Hard Problems.
**Intermediate 1:** Add Memoization (Top-Down) to Hard Problems to prevent redundant calculations.
**Intermediate 2:** Convert Hard Problems into a Tabulation (Bottom-Up) approach.
**Advanced:** Solve a 2D matrix or multi-state problem using Hard Problems.
**Expert/FAANG:** Optimize the space complexity of Hard Problems from O(N) to O(1) or O(N^2) to O(N).
